description_en: Calls DescribeDeploymentSetSupportedInstanceTypeFamily to query the instance families that support each deployment set strategy by specifying the RegionId and Strategy parameters
description_zh: 调用DescribeDeploymentSetSupportedInstanceTypeFamily，并指定RegionId、Strategy参数，查询支持各部署集策略的实例规格族
name: DescribeDeploymentSetSupportedInstanceTypeFamily

parameters.description_en: The region ID of the deployment set. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the deployment set. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list

parameters.description_en:
The deployment strategy. Valid values:

- Availability: high availability strategy.

- AvailabilityGroup: high availability strategy for deployment set groups.

- LowLatency: low network latency strategy.

Default value: Availability.
parameters.description_zh:
部署策略。取值范围：

- Availability：高可用策略。

- AvailabilityGroup：部署集组高可用策略。

- LowLatency：网络低时延策略。

默认值：Availability。
